name: Image Segmentation
learningObjectives: Understand pixel-wise classification for semantic segmentation
Learn how clustering algorithms can segment images into regions
Explore the role of color and position features in segmentation
Visualize segmentation masks with distinct colored regions
Evaluate segmentation quality using inertia and segment statistics

controls.label: Dataset
controls.tooltip: Choose an image dataset to segment

controls.label: Number of Segments
controls.tooltip: Number of distinct regions to segment the image into. More segments capture finer details.

controls.label: Max Iterations
controls.tooltip: Maximum number of clustering iterations. More iterations allow better convergence.

controls.label: Use Color Features
controls.tooltip: Include pixel intensity/color values as features for segmentation.

controls.label: Use Position Features
controls.tooltip: Include pixel position (x, y coordinates) as features. Helps create spatially coherent segments.

controls.label: Position Weight
controls.tooltip: Weight given to position features relative to color. Higher values create more spatially compact segments.

visualizations.title: Original Image
visualizations.description: The input image to be segmented

visualizations.title: Segmentation Mask
visualizations.description: Pixel-wise segmentation with colored regions for each segment

visualizations.title: Inertia Curve
visualizations.description: Sum of squared distances to cluster centers over iterations
